The watch is an Audemars Piguet Royal Oak, rose gold, blue dial with "Grande Tapisserie" pattern. The reference for the Royal Oak Jumbo Extra-Thin 16202 in pink gold with blue dial... Actually the blue dial with date at 3 o'clock, "AUDEMARS PIGUET" applied logo, and the thin bezel — this looks like the 16202BA? No, the Jumbo 15202 has no "AP" logo applied under... Actually the 15202BA has a blue dial with "AUDEMARS PIGUET" applied logo. Hmm.

Key features: date at 3 o'clock, applied gold "AUDEMARS PIGUET" logo at 12, no AP monogram above. Blue dial with Grande Tapisserie. Rose gold case and bracelet with the double-buckle (folding clasp) — the bracelet visible on the side shows the AP folding clasp style.

The Royal Oak "Jumbo" Extra-Thin 15202OR? The 15202 was made in rose gold with blue dial: 15202OR.OO.1240OR.01. That's the 39mm Jumbo rose gold blue dial (2012-2022). Actually 15202OR.OO.1240OR.01 is the pink gold Jumbo with blue dial. Yes, that reference exists.

But also the 16202OR.OO.1240OR.01, the new Jumbo pink gold blue dial (2022). Both look nearly identical; the 16202 has the new movement and a slightly different date font. Hard to distinguish. The 16202's dial has a slightly different blue. Hmm.

Which is more likely for a listing? The image shows a 39mm Royal Oak Jumbo. I'd guess 15202OR.OO.1240OR.01. But 16202OR.OO.1240OR.01 is the current version. The dial blue: 15202OR blue is more "blue" with a darker tone; 16202 is "smoked blue"? Actually 16202OR has blue dial same style.

Hmm, let's consider the more commonly seen: The rose gold 15202OR with blue dial was released in 2012. The 16202OR released in 2022 50th anniversary—but the 50th anniversary Jumbo rose gold had a "bleu nuit" dial with... Actually 16202OR.OO.1240OR.01 has a blue dial. The 50th anniversary had the oscillating weight.

There's also the Royal Oak 15400OR? No, the 15400 has a different dial with a smaller tapestry pattern? The 15400 has "Grande tapisserie" too, and a date at 3. But the 15400 dial lacks the applied "AUDEMARS PIGUET" logo — it has printed. Hmm, actually the 15400 has applied AP logo? The 15400 has "AUDEMARS PIGUET" printed? Let me recall: The 15400 dial has "AUDEMARS PIGUET" applied in gold letters — yes, it's applied. And the 41mm 15400 has a thicker bezel relative to... The 15202 Jumbo has a slimmer bezel and a thinner watch.

The photo: the watch looks relatively slim; bezel is relatively wide though. The date aperture at 3 with white background — the 15202 has a white date disc? The 15202OR has a date wheel with white background (matching dial? no, the 15202 blue dial has a white date). Actually the 15202 blue dial date has white background with black numerals. Hmm, in the photo, the date "7" appears dark on light background... hard to see.

The 16202OR has a date wheel with blue background? No.

Given ambiguity, I'd go with 15202OR.OO.1240OR.01, confidence moderate ~0.3.

Actually, let me think about the bezel: the Jumbo 15202OR has a thin bezel with 8 hexagonal screws. The 15400OR has a bigger... In the image the bezel appears moderately wide. Hard.

Also, the bracelet: the 15202 bracelet is thinner with a double-folding clasp. The photo shows the bracelet with the "AP" folding clasp links.

The hour markers: on the 15202, the hour markers are applied gold batons with luminous fill. Yes.

One clue: the 15202 dial has "AUDEMARS PIGUET" applied above center and no "AP" logo, and "SWISS MADE" at 6. The 15400 dial also has applied logo. Hmm.

Another clue: The dial pattern — the Grande Tapisserie on the 15202 is finer/smaller squares. The 15400 (41mm) has bigger squares? Actually the 15400's tapisserie pattern is larger relative.

I'll go 15202OR.OO.1240OR.01 with low confidence ~0.3.
